fullContentHtml:
UKSSSC Group C Scaler Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Uttarakhand Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UKSSSC) has released the notification for the Group C Scaler Posts. This recruitment has been issued for 200 posts. The online application process for UKSSSC Group C Scaler Recruitment 2026 will start from 22 September 2026, and candidates can apply till 22 October 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UKSSSC Group C Scaler Recruitment 2026, which are given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 22 September 2026
  • Last Date : 22 October 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 22 October 2026
  • Online Correction Date : 26-27 October 2026
  • PET/PST Exam Date : 19 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 300/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 150/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

UKSSSC Group C Scaler Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
